messages.content: Please finish the Philadelphia hotel comparison now. I need the real three-night totals, not just the room rates, and I need to know whether either hotel will actually hold my suitcase after checkout Thursday. Then book the better one.

I’ll verify November 3 through November 6 for one adult, including mandatory charges, breakfast, cancellation terms, late arrival, and a bag hold until late Thursday afternoon. Are you expecting to retrieve the bag around 4:30 p.m.?
Yes, about 4:30. My flight is at 7:05, and I’ll go back for it after the closing session.

Both hotels still have one-king rooms available for all three nights. The convention hotel is $249 per night plus a mandatory $25 nightly destination fee. Its 15.5% lodging tax applies to both the room and fee: $747 room, $75 fees, $127.41 tax, for $949.41 total. Breakfast is not included. The destination fee includes a daily $25 food-and-beverage credit, but unused credit does not reduce the bill.
And the nearby hotel? I want to be certain there isn’t another fee buried at checkout.

The nearby hotel’s flexible rate is $219 Monday, $229 Tuesday, and $239 Wednesday. That is $687 before tax and $793.49 after the same 15.5% tax. The property confirmed there is no destination, resort, facility, or service fee. Wi-Fi and the daily hot breakfast are included. The booking page’s final payment screen also shows $793.49 as the complete mandatory total.
So the difference is a little over $150? What are the cancellation rules on each one?

Yes. The nearby hotel is $155.92 less. Its flexible reservation can be canceled without charge through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on October 30. After that, the penalty is the first night plus tax, $252.95. The convention hotel allows free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on October 31; after that, its one-night penalty includes the room, destination fee, and tax, totaling $316.47.
The nearby one has the earlier cutoff, but that still works. Now confirm the late arrival and bag storage directly, especially that they won’t stop holding it at two or three.

The nearby hotel’s front desk is staffed 24 hours. I confirmed your Monday arrival can be noted for after 11:00 p.m.; the room will remain held because the reservation is guaranteed by card. For Thursday, registered guests may leave luggage with the front desk after checkout and retrieve it any time before 6:00 p.m. There is no storage charge. They issue a claim ticket, require it at pickup, and will not accept valuables or refrigerated items. Storage is subject to available space, but the desk confirmed that one standard suitcase until 4:30 p.m. is permitted and routine.
Does the convention hotel give me anything materially better besides the shorter walk?

It is about two minutes from the convention entrance instead of roughly seven minutes. It also permits luggage pickup until midnight. For this schedule, however, both hotels cover the 4:30 p.m. pickup, and the convention hotel’s food credit would not make up the $155.92 difference unless you used all $75 of it. Even then, it would remain $80.92 more and breakfast would still be separate.
Book the nearby hotel at the flexible rate. Add the late-arrival note and the Thursday bag note before you complete it.

The reservation page now shows the flexible king room, November 3-6, at $793.49 total. It is guaranteed with the card on file ending in 1842, with no advance charge; payment is due at the hotel. The notes request arrival after 11:00 p.m. Monday and storage of one suitcase after Thursday checkout until approximately 4:30 p.m. Shall I submit it?

Booked. The nearby hotel is confirmed for three nights under confirmation PHL-HAM-41872 at $793.49 including all mandatory taxes and charges. Nothing was charged today; the card ending in 1842 guarantees the stay. Free cancellation runs through 11:59 p.m. Eastern on October 30, followed by a $252.95 first-night penalty. Breakfast and Wi-Fi are included. The hotel has acknowledged the late-arrival note and the request to hold one standard suitcase Thursday until about 4:30 p.m.; collect a claim ticket when you leave it at the front desk. Your Philadelphia flights and hotel are now both finalized.
